jobs.title: Civil Engineer (Development)
jobs.description:
**Civils Engineer (Development)**

**Location** - Prenton offices, Wirral (with site visits across SP Manweb)

**Salary + benefits** - £45,400 - £56,750 with annual review, comprehensive pension scheme (company doubles your contribution up to 10%), plus extensive benefits package

**Closing date** - Monday 26th October

  
  

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

  

Our industry is experiencing unprecedented transformation as we work towards Net Zero. SP Energy Networks is delivering multiple projects simultaneously, overhauling our network to enhance resilience and secure electricity supply for our communities' economic growth. As a Civils Engineer (Development), you will play a vital role in this transformation by undertaking site inspections of substation construction projects from 11kV to 33kV. You will ensure works are carried out according to approved construction plans, SPEN building specifications, and best practice standards. Using your professional judgement and technical expertise, you will provide design and construction guidance to internal Design functions and external Framework Contractors. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on critical infrastructure that powers communities across the North West of England.

  
  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Conduct regular inspections of building work at various stages of completion, measuring and sampling building materials to verify their quality meets required standards
* Confirm that construction work aligns with approved plans and SPEN specifications, while providing technical design assistance to SPM Design, customer engagement teams, and other teams during project design phases
* Become well-versed in the SPEN Civil specification for Primary Substation Civil works, reviewing end-of-project returns including as-built documentation to ensure civil works are properly recorded within SPEN corporate systems
* Review financial applications made via framework arrangements to ensure they align with works delivered on site
* Maintain quality and consistency of technical and construction output across all projects
* Build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders and customers on behalf of ScottishPower, facilitating delivery of strategic goals
* Promote an exemplary safety culture, ensuring all safety legislation is implemented and delivered through activities and incorporated into project designs
* Contribute to team development by mentoring and training less experienced team members, graduates, and trainees, helping to build capability across the organization
* Manage a 6-month work bank of site inspections in coordination with design teams, overseeing civil works for Primary Projects in the delivery phase up to and including 33kV, typically valued at approximately £25m per annum
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* NVQ, HND, or bachelor's qualification in a construction-related subject such as building surveying, civil engineering, structural engineering, or construction management
* Membership of a relevant professional body such as the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS), the Chartered Association of Building Engineers (CABE), or the Chartered Institute of Building (CIOB) is highly valued
* Solid knowledge of structural and civil engineering design approaches and material properties
* Practical familiarity with construction methods and experience across common forms of construction
* Capability to interpret construction drawings with meticulous attention to detail
* Knowledge of building regulations, construction processes, legislation, and requirements
* 5 years or more of relevant experience, with great attention to detail and pride in design quality
* Full clean driving licence (required)
* Experience working in the electrical industry is desirable though not essential
* Strong numeracy and computer literacy skills
* Effective communication capabilities that enable you to provide clear advice and guidance
* Effective problem-solving skills and the capability to work well within a team environment
* Capacity to meet deadlines consistently
* Negotiation skills and the confidence to provide professional advice and guidance to colleagues and contractors
* Availability to travel as required across the region to fulfill site inspection accountabilities
  

  

**What's in it for you**

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action - our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world - today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:

* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase - perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers - save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes - to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network - connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's ambition to be Net Zero by 2044. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing >£5.5 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  
  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.

  
  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .

**Mobility**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements.

**I** **MPORTANT**

Advert will close at 23:59 GMT the day before **Job Posting End Date** below

October-26-2026

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Keywords Studios, established in Dublin in 1998, now has 70+ studios across Europe, North and South America and Asia with 12,000+ employee strength located across 5 continents and 26 countries. The company provides complete outsourced game art, engineering, testing, audio and localization service for all Console, PC, Handheld and Mobile content, to many of the biggest names in games and interactive entertainment, working on thousands of titles including many of the best-selling titles of the past few years.

Keywords Studios is comprised of many individual brands, all with something unique to offer our clients. The studios are integrated into the Group by Service Line and use the operating systems and tools deployed by those services lines to ensure people and projects can operate across studios and across geographies.

Keywords Studios Asia is currently hiring for Singapore based Software Engineers.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for enthusiastic and self-motivated Software Engineers to join our Singapore-based team, working on an exciting, new, and unannounced AAA project.

This is a generalist engineering role with a strong focus on providing front-line technical support to developers. You will investigate development issues, help unblock teams, apply corrective measures where appropriate, and ensure problems are directed to the relevant system owners when deeper investigation is required.

We are hiring across mid and senior levels, with responsibilities calibrated based on experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Investigate technical issues reported by developers and perform initial analysis to identify the likely cause.
* Apply corrective measures where appropriate, including fixing or rolling back broken compilation or build issues.
* Provide operational guidance to developers to help unblock their work, for example directing them to a stable or usable build.
* Escalate and route issues or JIRAs to the appropriate system owners when further specialist investigation is required.
* Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to support development and maintain a high-quality product.
* Test, debug, and refine systems and features throughout the development cycle.
* Estimate own tasks and deliver high-quality code according to agreed schedules.
* Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and development standards.

**Requirements:**

* Professional software engineering experience in games or related real-time interactive development.
* Strong proficiency in C++ and C# knowledge.
* Good familiarity with large C++ game codebases.
* Experience working with Perforce or similar source-control systems.
* Experience with commercial game engines such as Unreal Engine and/or Unity.
* Strong debugging, investigation, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable analysing unfamiliar technical issues and helping developers find practical ways to continue working.
* Comfortable working with distributed teams across different locations and collaborating clearly across disciplines.
* Experience contributing to at least one shipped game in a professional capacity.

**Nice to have:**

* Previous experience in a generalist engineering, developer support, build support, or firefighting role.
* Knowledge of industry-standard development practices including source control, asset pipelines, issue tracking, external QA, and localisation.
* Experience with continuous integration and build automation.
* Exposure to post-launch product development and delivery.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Experience with art packages and pipeline development.
* Experience with low-level optimisation, shader programming, physics, or mathematics.

  
**Benefits**

*Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any adjustments during the process please let us know in your application. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. We especially welcome applications from candidates of underrepresented groups in the industry.*

***PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY***

*By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at* *https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice**.*
